description: MultiAgentTrainer's execution config defaults to the unsandboxed local mode, so the autonomous autoresearch agent runs arbitrary shell commands directly on the host with no container boundary, command allow-list, or isolation unless a user manually configures ssh/docker instead.
input_parameter: {"config":{"execution":{"type":"local"},"agent_command":"autoresearch run --prompt {prompt}"},"note":"No sandbox, container, or command allow-list is applied in this (default) mode. Any code the autonomous agent decides to write during its _CONTINUE_PROMPT loop \u2014 including 'pip install <anything>' or a reverse shell \u2014 executes directly on the host that ran `mat train`."}
